body.statement: Proposition 29 of ManoleBalakrishnanNilesWeedWasserman2023CLT supplies the two-dimensional pointwise periodized-KDE optimal-transport Gaussian conclusion in the fixed-source uniform-to-uniform case; it does not establish the general variable-coefficient or generated-target case.

attestation.note: The scope boundary was checked against the proposition and the paper's discussion of the unresolved general-coefficient critical case.
